# The accept gate's own negative control

`nova-pulse accept --selftest` runs the gate over this fixture: one known-good fix,
which must be `ACCEPT OK`, and one seeded defect per reject token of the common gate,
each of which must be `ACCEPT REJECT` with that token and no other (SPEC-TOOLWORK §1
rules 6-8). `base/` is the module at the base commit, `fix/` the files the good commit
changes, `card.md` the card as cut would write it, `identity.txt` the pool identity the
fixture commits carry. Each `seeds/<name>/seed.txt` names its kind and the token it must
draw; a `patch` seed carries `seed.patch`, generated by git against the fix and applied
by git. Every seed is one edit and the count is asserted at run time, never trusted from
this directory. The `secret` seed's key-shaped string is generated at run time and is
not written here (§3 rule 6). The fixture's digest is part of `control=<id>`, so a
change to any file here is a new control.
